headline: Orthology and phylogenetic resources add structure-aware comparison and AI access
label: Biological Database Infrastructure
summary: OMA 2027 and OrthoDB 2026 expand genome coverage while adding structure-aware orthology and AI-agent support.
synthesis: The dominant thread is the scaling of reference resources and computational tools for phylogenetics and orthology. OMA 2027 reports 2983 extant and 1226 ancestral genomes with structure-aware orthology based on 3Di and structural alignments. OrthoDB 2026 covers 5768 eukaryotic genomes, recomputes orthologous groups with OrthoLoger and MMseqs2, rebuilds BUSCO eukaryote lineages and adds AI-agent support. Other items are tool-level advances: Big Tree Viewer renders phylogenies up to a million tips in the browser with taxonomy mapping and agentic AI integration, Hyperiax provides a JAX library for tree traversal and message passing, and TrailMix estimates mixture proportions and placement of ancient hominin mtDNA using a pangenome reference graph. What is new is the combination of structure-informed comparison and AI-agent access layers on top of established reference infrastructure.
